Summary

Analysis of CLB2 + ASH1, SUN4, SRL1, mRNAs by smFISH including bud segmentation. Population-level cell analysis in R started by EW on 8 July 2026, continued through 13 July 2026.

Goal is to produce figures summarising the dataset:

  • abundance and bud localization of mRNAs in wild-type
  • comparative bud localization in different strains
  • whatever cell statistics we need to support these arguments.

Load bud segmentation data

# make short table here of strain ids and names in desired order
strain_table <-
  tribble(~strain, ~condition, ~strain_nice,
    "YET915", "WT",    "WT",
    "YET916", "ΔSSD1", "ssd1Δ",
    "YET919", "ΔMPT5", "mpt5∆",
    "YET563", "ΔSHE2", "she2∆",
    "YET572", "ΔSHE3", "she3∆",
    "YET918", "ΔSUN4", "sun4∆",
    "YET921", "ΔSEC72","sec72∆"
    ) %>%
  mutate(strain_nice = as_factor(strain_nice))

scale_colour_mrna <- function(...) {
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("CLB2 + ASH1" = "magenta3", 
               "SRL1" = "goldenrod3", 
               "SUN4" = "forestgreen"),
    ...)
}
mrna_alldata <- here::here("data", "Mara_budSegmentationData20260311.csv") %>%
  read_csv() %>%
  select(!starts_with("Unnamed") ) %>%
  select(!"condition + strain") %>%
  rename(row_id = "...1") %>%
  mutate(replicate = 
           factor(replicate,
                  levels = c("BR1", "BR2", "BR3", "BR4", "BR5")),
         mRNA = factor(mRNA,
                       levels = c("ASH1CLB2", "SRL1", "SUN4"), 
                       labels = c("CLB2 + ASH1", "SRL1", "SUN4"), )
         ) %>%
  rename_with(str_replace_all, pattern = "-", replacement = "_") %>%
  left_join(strain_table, by = c("strain", "condition"))

Overview plots across strains

mRNAs per cell

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA, y = total_RNAs),
               outlier.size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

mRNAs per mother

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata, aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_mother),
               outlier.size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

mRNAs per bud, filtering only for budded cells

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area_bud > 0), 
       aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_bud),
               outlier.size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

Count vs total cell area for WT

plot_count_vs_area_WT <- 
  ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
           filter(area > 1000,
                  strain_nice %in% c("WT")),
         aes(x = area, y = total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = replicate, colour = mRNA),
              method = "loess", se = FALSE) + 
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) + 
  scale_colour_mrna() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  labs(x = "total cell area (pixels)",
       y = "mRNA count per cell") + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1),
         linetype = "none")

plot_count_vs_area_WT

Proportion in bud, across biological replicates, for most relevant strains

plot_propinbud_replicates <- 
  ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
           filter(area_bud > 0,
                  strain_nice %in% c("WT", "ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆", "she3∆")),
         aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs, 
                   group = interaction(strain_nice, replicate)),
               outlier.size = 0.2,
               position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_y_continuous("Proportion of mRNAs in bud",
                     limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_colour_mrna() +

Assign cell cycle phase based on cell statistics

The idea is:

  • G1 cells have no bud and nucleus in mother
  • S cells have small buds (under about 20 square microns)
  • G2 cells have larger buds but only one nucleus in mother
  • M cells have 2 nuclei in both bud and mother
  • some cells might be unassigned to “other”
mrna_alldata_wphase <-
  mrna_alldata %>%
  # filter for cells of sensible size - 2 um to 20 um
  filter(axis_major_length > 30,
         axis_major_length < 300) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_cycle_phase = 
      case_when(
        area_bud == 0 ~ "G1",
        area_bud > 0    & area_bud < 500  & 
          nuclei_bud_count == 0 ~ "S",
        area_bud >= 500 & area_bud < 3000 & 
          nuclei_bud_count == 0 ~ "G2",
        area_bud > 500  & 
          mother_nuclei_count == 1 & nuclei_bud_count == 1 ~ "M",
        .default = "NA"
      ) %>%
      factor(levels = c("G1", "S", "G2", "M", "other"))
  )

Check cell-level statistics for cell cycle phase.

mrna_alldata_wphase %>%
  filter(mRNA == "SUN4") %>%
  select(area, axis_major_length, area_bud, axis_major_length_bud, 
         cell_cycle_phase) %>%
  ggpairs(aes(colour = cell_cycle_phase), 
          lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", size = 0.2), 
                       combo = "box_no_facet",
                       discrete = "count") )
